basic_info.description: This bright and inviting open layout, 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom NoPa condo offers a peaceful retreat within minutes of some of San Francisco's hottest spots. The home enjoys a light-filled and expansive open concept kitchen, dining, and living room area, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. A wall of bay windows floods the living room with natural light, while a cozy gas fireplace adds warmth. Effortlessly host friends in the dining area, which easily accommodates a large dining table with seating for six. The well-appointed kitchen features ample storage space and a full suite of stainless steel appliances, including range, microwave, refrigerator, and dishwasher. Both bedrooms are spacious and enjoy plenty of natural light and large closets. The remodeled bathroom, situated between the bedrooms, includes a shower-over-tub. Additional features incl. ample private storage, one-car independent parking space, and a serene shared backyard with a fire pit, & views of the city skyline. Low dues of $400 per month in a 4-unit HOA. Superbly located within walking distance to the world-class restaurants, schools, grocery stores, and nightlife of the Nopa/Divisadero corridor, as well as Golden Gate Park, the Panhandle, public transit, and highways. Do not miss this gem!
